name: weighted standing neck extension (with head harness)
description: Standing and bent forward with a weighted harness, you raise your head against the load to build the back of the neck.
instructions: Fit the head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Stand and hinge forward, resting your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest.
Lift your head until your gaze is forward.
Lower slowly and keep the movement small and controlled.
